Lower Text: [Security] Play this card without paying the cost.
Upper Text: [Start of Your Main Phase] By placing 1 Digimon card with the [Blue Flare] or [Xros Heart] trait from your hand under any of your Tamers, gain 1 memory.
[All Turns] When any of your [Blue Flare] trait Digimon cards with DigiXros requirements would be played, by suspending this Tamer, cards from under your Tamers can also be placed for their DigiXros.
